definitions: A precious gemstone, a silicate mineral of aluminum and fluorine, typically yellow, orange, or blue.
A female given name derived from the gemstone.
A genus of hummingbirds in the family Trochilidae, native to South America.
examples: She wore a necklace with a large Topaz pendant.
Topaz was a popular name in the early 20th century.
The male Topaz hummingbird has iridescent plumage.
